# Take Video

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Takes a video.

## Syntax

~~~~text
takeVideo(camera: <#Enumeration (WFCameraCaptureDevice) (Optional)#>, quality: <#Enumeration (WFCameraCaptureQuality) (Optional)#>, start: <#Enumeration (WFRecordingStart) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
takeVideo(camera: Back, quality: Medium, start: Imediately)
~~~~
